1.web: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
1.asv: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

2.web: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
2.asv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Show me wherefore thou contendest with me.

3.web: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
3.asv: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

4.web: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
4.asv: Hast thou eyes of flesh? Or seest thou as man seeth?

5.web: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
5.asv: Are thy days as the days of man, Or thy years as man’s days,

6.web: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
6.asv: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin,

7.web: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
7.asv: Although thou knowest that I am not wicked, And there is none that can deliver out of thy hand?

8.web: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
8.asv: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

9.web: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
9.asv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?

10.web: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
10.asv: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?

11.web: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
11.asv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.

12.web: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
12.asv: Thou hast granted me life and lovingkindness; And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

13.web: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
13.asv: Yet these things thou didst hide in thy heart; I know that this is with thee:

14.web: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
14.asv: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

15.web: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still shall not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
15.asv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head; Being filled with ignominy, And looking upon mine affliction.

16.web: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
16.asv: And ifmy head exalt itself, thou huntest me as a lion; And again thou showest thyself marvellous upon me.

17.web: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
17.asv: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, And increasest thine indignation upon me: Changes and warfare are with me.

18.web: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
18.asv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me.

19.web: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
19.asv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

20.web: Aren’t my days few? Cease then. Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
20.asv: Are not my days few? cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

21.web: before I go where I shall not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
21.asv: Before I go whence I shall not return, Evento the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

22.web: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
22.asv: The land dark as midnight, The landof the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as midnight.
